run_metadata.coverage_summary: WebSearch-only discovery run. External WebFetch/egress remained fully blocked by the organisation egress proxy (EGRESS_BLOCKED, HTTP 403) again this run — reconfirmed with live WebFetch calls to https://www.tenders.gov.au/atm and https://www.tenders.nsw.gov.au (both EGRESS_BLOCKED). Proxy status endpoint reports healthy (enabled:true, bundleCoversEveryHost:true, recentRelayFailures empty); per /root/.ccr/README.md a 403 from the proxy is a non-retryable organisation egress-policy denial, so no tender detail page or specification document could be opened. Every opportunity is therefore captured from WebSearch only: existence/ID/open-status from verifiable result link <title> text (e.g. 'Current ATM View - <ID>: AusTender', treated as reliable), and any buyer/title/date/scope detail from WebSearch answer snippets (which summarise the target page and are treated as SNIPPET-DERIVED / not independently verified, flagged in each entry's notes and detail_source). Tier 1 Commonwealth (AusTender) and all eight state/territory portals (NSW buy.nsw, VIC Buying for Victoria, QLD QTenders/eTender, WA Tenders WA, SA Tenders SA, TAS Tenders Tasmania, NT QTOL, ACT Tenders) were probed via search. AusTender surfaced FIVE new buyer-originated Current-ATM notices not present in the routine's 505 known dedup keys nor matching a known detail-page GUID: CSIRORFT2026006 (CSIRO Manuscript Editorial Platform), MTS RFI (Dept of Veterans' Affairs Modern Transport Services market sounding), S-EST08611 (Dept of Defence DSRG Greenvale Training Area Road Works, QLD), AZ 6227 (Defence, headline-only) and CASRFI-2026 (headline-only). All five are captured; those with consistent search snippets carry snippet-derived buyer/title/closing detail (clearly flagged), the other two are headline-only. Notably EXCLUDED: NSW Health 'HSSP_HC18_808' returned a 'Current Tender Detail View' link title but its snippet identifies it as a 2018 tender (Cardiovascular Prosthesis, published/closed Aug 2018, addendum Oct 2022) — stale index, not a recent opportunity, so not captured; TfNSW 23.0000129385.1420 likewise carries a 2023-vintage ID and could not be confirmed as recent — deferred (see gaps). State portals VIC/QLD/WA/SA/TAS/NT and buy.nsw returned only landing/search pages or aggregator (australiantenders.com.au / tenderhub / globaltenders) results with no buyer-originated verifiable individual link title — several snippet-only items noted in gaps but not captured. Tier 2 (universities, GBE water utilities, VendorPanel councils) sampled: University of Adelaide (Poultry Roof Replacement, Flood Mitigation Consultant), Monash (Quantity Surveyor panel, Media Monitoring), UTS (Body Donation funeral/cremation, Photography/Videography panel), Melbourne Water (Field Services Panel RFT), Sydney/SA Water, and VendorPanel councils (Cootamundra-Gundagai, Logan, Rockhampton) all surfaced only via aggregators or portal landing pages with no buyer-originated verifiable individual link title — deferred, not captured. Tier 3 (mandatory) attempted: SAP Business Network Discovery/Ariba, BHP Find Opportunities, Rio Tinto Buy Local, Fortescue, Woodside — all corporate opportunity detail is registration- or invitation-gated and none was publicly visible via search, so corporate portals are recorded in discovered_sources only, never fabricated as tenders. Source-discovery pass: the only novel item surfaced was the AusTender Supplier Portal / GovPanels enhancement (part of tenders.gov.au, buyer-originated Commonwealth, expanding to all businesses from 1 July 2026) — it sits under the already-known AusTender source and is a supplier-registration database rather than an opportunity feed, so it is recorded as a recommended seed addition, not counted as a new source. All other novel domains encountered (tenderhub.com.au, globaltenders.com, bidsfactory.com, tenderimpulse.com, bidio.ai, australiatenderalerts.com) are third-party aggregators/scrapers excluded by the buyer-originated rule. No genuinely new buyer-originated source found this run.
gaps: WebFetch/egress fully blocked (EGRESS_BLOCKED, HTTP 403 from the organisation egress proxy) for ALL external hosts this run — reconfirmed with live WebFetch to www.tenders.gov.au/atm and www.tenders.nsw.gov.au. Per /root/.ccr/README.md this is a non-retryable organisation egress-policy denial. No tender detail page or specification document could be opened; all five captured tenders require an authenticated/unblocked run for full deliverables, requirements, evaluation criteria, documents and contacts. Where buyer/title/dates are shown they are WebSearch snippet-derived (page summaries indexed by the search engine), not read from the notice itself.

Excluded stale index: NSW Health 'HSSP_HC18_808' had a 'Current Tender Detail View' link title (tenders.nsw.gov.au/health, RFTUUID B2769A41-02DD-BD5B-4561EF497C73727D) but its snippet identifies it as a 2018 tender (Cardiovascular Prosthesis & Associated Consumables, HealthShare NSW, published 3-Aug-2018, closed 31-Aug-2018, Addendum 3 to 26-Oct-2022). Treated as a stale index entry, not a recent opportunity — not captured.

Deferred (recency unconfirmed): Transport for NSW 'Current Tender Detail View - 23.0000129385.1420' (tenders.nsw.gov.au/TfNSW, RFTUUID B5E8E1B3-A570-537D-19D57ABF55CE6E7E). ID prefix '23.' suggests a 2023 vintage and no snippet confirmed a current closing date; not captured pending an unblocked detail pass.

AZ 6227 (AusTender Current ATM, GUID d8830548-df75-41d8-aa43-364fe82e9fc3): only the verifiable link <title> is available; buyer (likely Defence from the 'AZ' estate prefix but NOT confirmed), title, category, dates, value and scope are egress-blocked and recorded null/blank — not inferred. Headline-level only.

CASRFI-2026 (AusTender Current ATM, GUID dbf2a3e6-81e2-49ae-8c21-41fbae305c3c): only the verifiable link <title> is available; buyer, title, dates and scope egress-blocked and null. Headline-level only.

Snippet-only AusTender items already known and not re-captured: RFT13109, 10018162, OPC-2026-03 (the 'OPC- 2026-03' link title resolves to the already-known GUID 7de3a2a6-4efc-4595-b0f1-db6d3164e2e1), plus known RFI_ATM_2026_6026 (Solar Panel Recycling Pilot, DCCEEW), PR10031930-RASS, ATM_2026_3858, ASCA-RFT-2026-LDTPM, RFT 02-2026.

State/territory portals VIC, QLD, WA, SA, TAS, NT and buy.nsw returned only landing/search pages or aggregator results with no buyer-originated verifiable individual link title. Snippet-only items deferred (not captured, IDs/URLs unverified): SA 'Devices Refresh 2026/27' (closing 07-Oct-2026), SA 'Detailed Earthworks & Concrete C5001 - Hillside Project' (closing 07-Oct-2026), SA 'Mount Gambier Civil Works' (posted 17-Sep-2026); TAS Sorell municipality 100mm base gravel re-sheet (from 9-Sep-2026) and Huon Valley Council Facilities Maintenance & Trade Services; WA WAPHA RFQ1104 Primary Care Training FDSV Pilot (Perth South PHN, closing 2-Oct-2026); NSW Destination NSW Vivid Sydney site management (closing 6-Oct-2026) and Wingecarribee Shire Council sports-field lighting (closing 29-Sep-2026).

Tier 2 universities/TAFEs and GBE water utilities surfaced only via aggregators (australiantenders.com.au, tenderhub.com.au, globaltenders.com) without a buyer-originated verifiable link title: University of Adelaide (Poultry Roof Replacement posted 21-Sep-2026; Flood Mitigation Consultant posted 8-Sep-2026), Monash University (Quantity Surveyor Services Approved Supplier Panel; Media Monitoring Services), University of Technology Sydney (Body Donation Program Funeral & Cremation Services; Photography & Videography panel), Melbourne Water Field Services Panel RFT, Sydney Water and SA Water. Deferred pending an unblocked buyer-portal pass.

Tier 3 corporate (SAP Business Network Discovery/Ariba, BHP Find Opportunities, Rio Tinto Buy Local, Fortescue, Woodside): opportunity detail is registration- or invitation-gated and none was publicly visible via search. Portals recorded in discovered_sources only; no corporate tender fabricated. Invitation-only corporate RFx remain out of scope and undiscoverable.

No genuinely new buyer-originated source found this run. The AusTender Supplier Portal / GovPanels enhancement (help.tenders.gov.au/.../govpanels-supplier-portal) is part of the already-known AusTender source and is a supplier-registration database, not an opportunity feed — recorded as a recommended seed addition rather than a new source.
recommended_seed_additions: AusTender Supplier Portal / GovPanels (https://help.tenders.gov.au/getting-started-with-austender/central-procurement-systems-enhancements/govpanels-supplier-portal/) — Commonwealth supplier-registration database inside AusTender, opening to all businesses from 1 July 2026; worth tracking for supplier-onboarding and panel visibility, though it is a registration database rather than an opportunity feed.

tenders.title: Request for Information for Modern Transport Services
tenders.description: Current Approach to Market (Request for Information) on AusTender (ID 'MTS RFI'). Per the WebSearch snippet, the Department of Veterans' Affairs seeks market information to inform how to modernise existing transport services for DVA clients travelling to attend compensable treatment, including transport booking and payment systems.
tenders.deliverables_summary: Snippet-derived: a market sounding (RFI) to inform development of a modern transport service for eligible DVA clients — simplifying booking and payment, enhancing veteran autonomy and choice, with no out-of-pocket expenses. No supplier deliverables are contracted at the RFI stage; full scope not retrievable this run (notice egress-blocked).
